newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Pharma says in acquisition talks.
newsitem.headline: China Pharma says in acquisition talks.

text.p: Vitamin C maker China Pharmaceutical Enterprise and Investment Corp Ltd said it was in talks to buy a 72.99 percent stake in Hebei Zhongkang Pharmaceutical Co Ltd from Hebei Pharmaceutical Group Co Ltd.

The statement said the proposed acquisition would increase China Pharmaceutical's interest in Hebei Zhongkang to 99 percent from 26.99 percent, while the remaining one percent interest would continue to be held by Hebei Pharmaceutical.
The terms and conditions for the proposed acquistion have yet to be finalised, it said.
Hebei Pharmaceutical is a company recently bought by China Pharmaceutical's controlling shareholder Shijiazhuang Pharmaceutucal Group Co Ltd, the statement said.
Hebei Zhongkang is a Sino-foreign joint venture in Shijiazhuang City in China's Hebei province, it said.
China Pharmaceutical said the proposed acquisition, if it proceeds, would be subject to approval from its independent shareholders and relevant authorities in China.
The company shares fell HK$0.03 to HK$1.20 around midday on volume of 4.50 million shares.
